## Findings

- The tokens row was wrong: it said theme CSS is generated and not committed, so the plan for #3685 routed the change through Tokens Studio, while the committed export in `scripts/themes/export/` is what the fix edited.
  Found by the skill's own section 8 after the developer's correction; applied in a shorter form: plan the edit in the export, say whether Tokens Studio needs the same change, list what else uses the token.
- Section 8 stayed silent in the 4 runs where nothing went wrong, as intended.
